sentences.en: He was still as still in the presence of danger.
sentences.zh: 他即使在危险面前也依然镇定自若。

sentences.en: It may be unwise of you to advertise your presence.
sentences.zh: 你公开露面可能会有些不明智。

sentences.en: I am highly honored by the presence of the president.
sentences.zh: 有总统出席我感到非常荣幸。

senses.zh: 出席，到场；存在，有；仪态，风度；影响力，声望
